note: In aspen and lodgepole on a bench above the whitewater of Lake Creek, ~9,600 ft, west of Twin Lakes Reservoir and Twin Lakes Village on paved CO-82 (inside CDOT's Independence Pass 35-ft vehicle restriction, which starts about a mile west of US-24); views of the Sawatch Range, Mount Elbert and Continental Divide trails nearby; Leadville RD. --Claude
summary: FS campground page (found; stored website was the PSICC home page) + recreation.gov (10165716) + CDOT: confirmed 35 sites, FCFS, $28 (2026 and 2027), vault toilets, no water (2026); added max 35 ft (some sites 25), season May-Sept, Scan & Pay/fee tube, 50% pass discount. Note cleaned; corrected the CO-82 limit wording (the campground is inside the 35-ft zone, not below it). Not waterfront kept.
flags: Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc is the forest home page. Use https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/twin-peaks-campground (and recreation.gov https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165716, a first-come Scan & Pay listing).

Phone: none stored. Leadville Ranger District, 810 Front Street, Leadville, 719-486-0749 (FS page, Office Contact Information). recreation.gov's (661) 702-1420 and tbolton@goexplorus.com are the concessionaire's (Explorus). Suggest 719-486-0749.

CO-82 length limit: CDOT (May 19, 2026) 'commercial and recreational vehicles 35 feet or longer are prohibited on Independence Pass ... applies to vehicles and trailers with a combined length of more than 35 feet ... between Mile Point 47.2 (west side, near Aspen) and MP 84.2 (east side, near Twin Lakes/Leadville and about one mile west of the junction with US Highway 24).' Twin Peaks is west of Twin Lakes Village, so it is INSIDE the restricted stretch, not 'below' it as the old note said. EKKO (23 ft) is unaffected; anything 35 ft+ cannot legally reach it from either side. No criteria problem.

Length: FS 'Some sites can hold trailers up to 35 feet, while others can only hold 25 feet.' Both figures over 23 ft. recreation.gov's catalog has a single placeholder site with no length. Recorded 35.
Operator: concessionaire (FS 'concessionaire-run campsites'; recreation.gov contact @goexplorus.com). Ownership federal stands.
Pin 39.06754,-106.42139 equals the FS and recreation.gov point, at the campground entrance off CO-82. OK.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept (checked both ways): on NAIP the loops lie between CO-82 and Lake Creek (a ~8-14 m stream with gravel bars, so creekside-sized). The south loops end ~40-50 m above the creek under conifers; a few west-end spurs come within ~30-35 m, but the canopy hides whether any site has an open apron to the water. Not earned on the evidence; the FS describes the campground as 'above the whitewater of Lake Creek'.
